trigger_description: The currently-granted master issues any request (cyc asserted) to the full 32-bit trap address 0x00000A00 -- unreachable by golden-testbench traffic (random addresses cap at 0x3FC, fixed addresses cap at 0x500).
observable_effect: A sticky latch (hold_latched) permanently set on first trigger, never cleared except by reset. Once set, the arbiter's lock-release condition is permanently disabled: `lock` can never deassert again, meaning NO future arbitration decision can ever occur. Whichever master held the bus at trigger time keeps it forever in name only (lock stuck at 1); in practice this permanently denies bus access to the OTHER master for the remainder of operation -- a genuine, irreversible denial-of-service, not a transient one-cycle glitch.
